skill.name: personal-finance-visualizer
skill.description: Turn user-provided personal finance records into a local interactive report with spending, income, transfers, cash movement and optional daily budgets in English or Chinese. Use for statement-based finance charts and period comparisons, not bank-account actions or investment advice.
skill.summary: Visualize reconciled personal finances in local English or Chinese reports with optional daily allowances.
skill.author: jasonhmy

security_audit.summary: All 130 static findings are false positives involving interface code, validation, documentation, or explicitly authorized local operations. Network behavior is limited to an optional same-origin budget integration and a separate public GitHub release lookup. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential collection, financial-data exfiltration, or hidden command execution in the reviewed files.

content.user_title: Visualize Personal Spending and Daily Budgets
content.value_statement: Financial statements can obscure spending patterns when transfers, refunds, and shared costs are mixed together. This skill prepares reconciled records and renders local interactive reports with optional daily allowances.
actual_capabilities: Render normalized JSON or CSV into local interactive spending, income, transfer, and cash-movement views.
Navigate day, week, month, and year periods with chart tooltips and searchable transaction details.
Calculate confirmed personal shares, full-refund exclusions, and transfer settlements while retaining original bank amounts.
Switch between English and Simplified Chinese interfaces and between area and bar timelines.
Calculate optional daily allowances with monthly resets, coverage checks, and historical or manual category allocations.
Serve reports through a tokenized loopback URL or create a private HTML export after an explicit save request.
limitations: Raw bank exports need explicit field mapping; PDF extraction depends on authorized tools outside this skill.
Each report supports one currency with two decimal places; currency conversion is not implemented.
The skill does not connect bank accounts, move money, forecast pending charges, or provide investment advice.
Cross-device budget persistence requires a separately supplied authenticated same-origin backend; standalone edits remain in page memory.

use_cases.title: Review Household Spending
use_cases.description: Compare monthly household expenses using confirmed personal shares and refunds without counting internal account transfers as spending.

use_cases.title: Separate Income From Transfers
use_cases.description: Review supplied freelance records, classify uncertain receipts, and distinguish confirmed income from transfers across covered periods.

use_cases.title: Track a Daily Allowance
use_cases.description: Use confirmed living costs and current source coverage to calculate a daily cap with historical or manual category shares.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Fictional Finances
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a local English report using only the bundled fictional demo data. Do not read my files or export a report.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: explore the report without supplying personal records.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Authorized CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my supplied CSV for [period] in [currency]. Confirm column mappings and uncertain transactions before showing final monthly spending charts in [language].
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: turn an authorized statement export into a verified report.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Multiple Accounts
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile the supplied same-currency account records for [period]. Ask about uncertain internal transfers, personal shares, refunds, and repayments before producing final charts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: separate personal spending from account movement.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Daily Allowances
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a daily allowance with [daily limit], [timezone], and [expense groups]. Confirm coverage and category allocation. Keep settings in page memory without endpoint integration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: add a budget without deploying persistent storage.

output_examples.input: Illustrative records contain a USD 100 shared expense with a confirmed 50% personal share and a USD 200 internal transfer.
output: The internal transfer does not count as external cash movement.
Transaction details retain the original bank amounts and confirmed personal share.

output_examples.input: Illustrative records contain a confirmed USD 84 purchase in February and its matching USD 84 full refund in March.
output: The matched purchase contributes no personal spending in February.
Cash movement retains the February payment and March refund on their original bank dates.
The report links the confirmed refund while retaining both transaction records.

output_examples.input: A daily allowance is requested, but the supplied records do not cover the start of the current month.
output: The report identifies missing early-month records.
Budget settings remain visible, but incomplete coverage is not presented as a reliable current allowance.

best_practices: Confirm coverage, signs, currency, account ownership, and uncertain classifications before finalizing affected charts.
Pass newly normalized records through supported process stdin and use account aliases instead of account numbers.
Keep report links private, stop the local server after review, and export only to an explicitly authorized local destination.
anti_patterns: Guessing income, duplicate identity, personal shares, or refund matches from matching names, dates, or amounts alone.
Publishing embedded transaction reports or placing real records in repositories, public issues, or saved demonstration screenshots.
Treating partial account coverage or stale records as a complete financial picture or reliable current spending allowance.

faq.question: Can this skill log into my bank or transfer money?
faq.answer: No. It works with authorized records you supply and does not perform bank-account actions.

faq.question: Which input formats are supported?
faq.answer: The renderer accepts normalized JSON or CSV. Raw bank exports need mapping, and PDFs require an available authorized extraction tool.

faq.question: Does financial data leave my computer?
faq.answer: The renderer uses local delivery without telemetry. Agent hosting may retain supplied data; optional budget integration sends settings to a same-origin endpoint.

faq.question: Can I mix currencies or change the interface language?
faq.answer: Use separate reports for each supported two-decimal currency. The interface supports English and Simplified Chinese.

faq.question: Are reports and budget edits saved automatically?
faq.answer: Reports stay in memory unless you request an export. Standalone budget edits reset on reload; cross-device saving requires a separate authenticated backend.

faq.question: How are uncertain transactions and incomplete coverage handled?
faq.answer: The workflow asks for clarification before final charts. Explicit provisional previews disclose unresolved items, and missing or stale coverage can disable current allowances.
